Name: BulkStaircases2.0
Author: bananafruit476
Description:
[b]BulkStaircases[/b] is a [url=https://stardewvalley.net/]Stardew Valley[/url] mod which lets you use multiple [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Staircase]staircases[/url] at once.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Use[/size]
Press [Shift] + [C] (configurable) to descend mine levels while having staircases in inventory.
Special levels (e.g. treasure rooms, infested levels,... ) can be configured to not be skipped. By default, all [b]special levels will not be skipped[/b].

[size=5]Configure[/size]
[size=4]config.json[/size]
The mod creates a `config.json` file in its mod folder the first time you run it. You can open that
file in a text editor to configure the mod as well as use ingame [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Some options are only available via text editing.

These are the available settings:

[i]﻿NumberOfStaircasesToLeaveInStack[/i]
Default `0`. Number of staircases that will not be used. In case you may want to use those manually later.

[i]MaxLevelsToSkipPerUse[/i]
Default `0`. How many levels to skip maximally per use. 0 indicates no restriction.

[i]DoNotSkipSkullCavernLevels[/i]
Default `[100, 200, 300]`. Which skull cavern levels are not to be skipped.

DoNotSkipMineLevels
Default `[]`. Which mine levels are not to be skipped.

[i]SkipDinosaurLevels[/i]
Default `false`. Whether to skip prehistoric floors.

[i]SkipTreasureLevels[/i]
Default `false`. Whether to skip levels with a treasure.

[i]SkipQuarryDungeonLevels[/i]
Default `false`. Whether to skip quarry dungeon levels that may appear after having been to the quarry mine.

[i]SkipSlimeLevels[/i]
Default `false`. Whether to skip slime infested levels.

[i]SkipMonsterLevels[/i]
Default `false`. Whether to skip monster infested levels.

[i]SkipMushroomLevels[/i]
Default `false`. Whether to skip mushroom levels.

[i]MonsterFilters[/i]
Default empty. Dictionary containing monster names and the minimum number of
these monsters being present for a level not to be skipped.
For example, the entry
[code]﻿  "MonsterFilters": {
    "Iridium Bat": 3,
    "Pepper Rex": 2,
    "Dust Spirit": 5
  },
[/code]won't skip levels that contain at least 3 Iridium Bats or at least 2 Pepper Rex or at least 5 Dust Spirits.
[b]!Warning![/b]
The monster names must be taken from <StardewValleyFolder>\Content (unpacked)\Data\Monsters.json
For example Dust Sprites are called "Dust Spirit" internally.

[i]NodeFilters
[/i]Default
[code]﻿  "NodeFilters": {
    "Iridium Node": 0,
    "Radioactive Node": 0
  },
[/code]Adjust the number of these nodes to not skip levels that have at least that many nodes available. For example if you don't want to skip levels with at least 5 iridium nodes or at least 3 radioactive nodes, the settings would be:
[code]﻿  "NodeFilters": {
    "Iridium Node": 5,
    "Radioactive Node": 3
  },[/code]

[i]ToggleKey[/i]
The configured controller, keyboard, and mouse buttons (see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Key_bindings]key bindings[/url]).
You can separate multiple buttons with commas. The default value is `LeftShift + C` to descend the levels.
